name: ospalek-mobile
description: Nativní obal Ospalku pro Android a iOS (Capacitor). Webová aplikace zůstává v ../app.

scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.android:build: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:run: npm run sync && cap run android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run sync && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build build
scripts.ios:run: npm run sync && cap run ios
